entries.headline: EAM header MMB2HV reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code MMB2HV.

entries.headline: U.S. transport, command and reconnaissance activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four U.S. military transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with a reconnaissance aircraft operating over the North Sea. It also reported 13 coded broadcasts logged during the day.

entries.headline: EAM header M6B2HV reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code M6B2HV.

entries.headline: Spanish train-collision report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Meduza report of two high-speed trains colliding in Spain and at least 10 deaths, saying three outlets later confirmed it. The visible post was truncated after attributing the casualty figure to emergency services.

entries.headline: Transport-aircraft activity and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including four over the continental United States. It also reported 12 coded radio broadcasts logged during the day.

entries.headline: U.S. command, surveillance and transport activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear command aircraft and reconnaissance aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside multiple transport aircraft and a surveillance drone. It also reported 12 coded radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: GRIFF01 E-4B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing E-4B GRIFF01, registration 73-1676 and hex ADFEB3. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Coded-broadcast surge and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly five times their normal worldwide level, with a nuclear command aircraft and transport aircraft active over the United States. The report credited reagan0965.

entries.headline: EAM header WEIJ7U reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code WEIJ7U. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Chinese spaceplane intelligence report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report credited to reagan0965 stating that U.S. intelligence had confirmed the identity of China’s secret spaceplane and that its design was very similar to one used by the U.S. Space Force. The visible post was truncated after that comparison.

entries.headline: SCORE90 RQ-4 Global Hawk sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Northrop Grumman RQ-4 Global Hawk SCORE90, registration 168459 and hex AE5C73. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: TOPCT72 TC-135W sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing TC-135W TOPCT72, registration 62-4127 and hex AE1254. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.
